A sanctioned dark fleet Suezmax, with a long history of carrying Iranian crude oil, and which carried an Iranian cargo as recently as August 2026, was just sold for scrap to an Indian yard. She has been delivered.

Looks like one dark fleet owner is giving up... 🧐

One month ago, a 19-year old Suezmax tanker, Suez Enchanted, was reported sold for $49M. This was considered “record-breaking”. 

Now, 25-year old Suezmax “GRAFF” (b. 2001 at NKK Corp., 151,000 dwt) is reported sold for > $45M USD. The buyer is Greek. 🇬🇷
